Oppo Reno17 and Reno17 Pro Additionally, the company said the device will be available in stores on that date, so customers can have an in-person experience. title: We checked out Chromagraph, Rian Johnson's viral iPhone camera app
description: Last week, a corner of the internet started going abuzz at the sight of a new app. The app in question was Chromagraph, a photography app for the iPhone, and one with some serious credentials to back it up. The app was first brought to people’s attention by one of the co-creators himself. Many of you would be familiar with Rian Johnson, but for those who aren’t, Johnson is the writer/director behind films such as Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Looper, and most recently, the Knives Out trilogy. title: Sony Xperia 10 VII and Xperia 10 VIII receive Android 17 update
description: Sony released the Android 17 update for the Xperia 1 VIII in September and expanded the rollout to the Xperia 1 VII last month. Now, Sony has released Android 17 for two more smartphones - the Xperia 10 VII and the Xperia 10 VIII. Sony hasn't mentioned which regions it's seeding the update to, but we expect it to reach the UK and Europe first, since that's where Android 17 for the Xperia 1 VIII and Xperia 1 VII rolled out first. Sony Xperia 10 VIII With the Android 17 update, Xperia 10 VII and Xperia 10 VIII users get an updated “Wallpaper & style” feature, along with refreshed...

title: Here's when the Huawei Mate 80 Air is rumored to launch
description: Huawei unveiled the Mate 70 Air around one year ago as its entry into the 'thin smartphone' segment, and while its successor has been rumored for a while now, it's still nowhere to be seen. Today, a tipster on Weibo claims the Mate 80 Air will launch next month. The same tipster also says the MatePad Mini's successor, the MatePad Mini 2, won't be launched alongside the handset, even though it may also be released in December, despite earlier rumors claiming it would be coming this month. title: Samsung Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Buds3 Pro will soon work as hearing aids
description: Back in the summer, Samsung's Hearing Aid feature for the Galaxy Buds got cleared by the FDA in the US. Today, the company announced that its Hearing Test and Hearing Aid features have also received medical device approval in South Korea, from the country's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). Both features are coming to the Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Galaxy Buds3 Pro through a software update, with the rollout in Korea set to start in early 2027. Samsung hasn't said when owners in the US will get them, even though the FDA clearance came first. The Hearing Test is based on...

title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max's battery capacity leaks, and it's huge
description: Just yesterday, the Redmi Turbo 6 Max's screen details leaked, and before that it was rumored to come with a battery of over 10,000 mAh. Now, a reliable tipster has gotten more specific on that front. According to him, the phone is confirmed to have an 11,000 mAh battery, rated at 40.72Wh. He didn't name the device outright, but he described a Dimensity-powered performance phone with a 7-inch 2K screen and an ultra-high refresh rate, which matches everything we've heard about the Turbo 6 Max so far. title: Huawei's upcoming sub-brand gets an English name, first two phones detailed
description: Last month, a report claimed that Huawei was preparing a new sub-brand called Xingmang, which translates to "Starlight" or "Starburst". Shortly after, a tipster said its first phone would be a wide-screen candybar, but also warned that Starlight / Starburst was just a translation and might not end up as the brand's actual name. Now, two reliable leakers say the English name will be Osta, and that's allegedly also what will be printed on the retail boxes. title: Oppo's new F35 Pro gets the ColorOS 17 update
description: Oppo today announced that it is bringing its ColorOS 17 update to the newly launched Oppo F35 Pro. This is part of the company's rollout of its new operating system, which is currently in its third wave. For F-series devices exclusively, ColorOS 17 adds a feature called ColorOS Smoothness Boost, which further optimizes system responsiveness for a consistently fluid experience over extended use. This combines with ColorOS 17's Laminar Flow engine to improve everyday performance. Other additions include AI Call Guard, which alerts users to potential fraud involving synthetic...

title: Xiaomi tipped to be working on a wide-screen candybar smartphone
description: Several smartphone brands are reportedly working on wide-screen candybar phones inspired by the Huawei Pura X View. Now, a new rumor suggests that Xiaomi is also planning to enter the segment with its own offering. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, an Android smartphone maker is currently testing a wide-screen candybar phone. While the tipster did not explicitly name the company, the emoji used in the post hints that the device could be from Xiaomi. description: The iPhone Duo has been shipping for a little while now, but plenty of iOS apps still haven't been adapted to its two displays. Google Maps is no longer one of them, as version 26.44.4 of the app is now being reported to add full support for the device. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] While Google's App Store release notes only mention "bug fixes", if you already use Google Maps on the iPhone Duo, you'll notice the difference right away. title: Apple releases first iOS 27.3 developer beta, here's what's new
description: Apple has released the first iOS 27.3 developer beta to testers, bringing several new features and changes. The company also rolled out the first developer betas of iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, tvOS 27.3, and visionOS 27.3. The iOS 27.3 beta 1 introduces a redesigned Health app alongside several Audio Intelligence features such as Siri Recap and Live Rewind on the Apple Watch. description: Hollywood-favorite ARRI is partnering with Honor in an attempt to escape the movie studios and slide into more and more consumer pockets. title: Oppo Find N7 officially confirmed to arrive in Europe
description: Some good news for foldable fans came from an interview with one of Oppo's regional Product Managers. Speaking to local publication Nixanbal he revealed that Oppo is planning to release the Oppo Find N7 in Europe, after the N6 missed the Old Continent entirely. The Oppo Find N6 is easily among the best foldable phones around and while it did go international it never officially made it to Europe. title: Samsung UK drops prices of Galaxy S26 phones by £250, Z Fold8 price by £100 for Black Friday
description: Samsung UK is running a Black Friday promo campaign that drops the prices of many of its premium Galaxy devices. There is a variety of offers – most are valid until December 1, but the best phone offers expire on November 17. Starting with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, you can get £100 off with PayPal, plus a £30-£713 bonus when trading in an old device (these are the trade-in values of a Galaxy S20 128GB and a Galaxy Z Fold7 1TB, respectively). Samsung is making a “Black Friday Price Promise” – if you find the Z Fold8 for a lower price on select online retailers than on Samsung.com...

title: Oppo smartphone with 12,000mAh battery gets certification
description: Oppo could be gearing up to launch a smartphone with a massive 12,000mAh battery. An upcoming Oppo device, featuring the large-capacity cell, has reportedly received certification from China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). According to the source, an Oppo smartphone bearing the model number PNC110 has received the MIIT approval in China. While the listing does not explicitly mention a 12,000mAh battery, its metadata reveals that the device packs an 11,460mAh cell, which could be marketed as a 12,000mAh battery. title: Schools that want Google Search for students will have to accept its AI too
description: Google has announced that its AI products will soon be switched off by default for K-12 student accounts. Namely, Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search will be "entirely off" until school administrators explicitly turn them on. In case you missed it, Google Search is on that list. The company says Search and AI are "deeply integrated", so a school that wants no AI at all for its students also has to give up Search for them. title: New info reveals the Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro won't be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
description: There's been a lot of talk lately about the chipset powering the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, with a recent rumor claiming the smartphone would come with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, at least in Europe. Now, the entire S27 lineup has been spotted in the NBD database, with the S27 Ultra listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. The Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ are listed with Samsung's Exynos 2700 SoC, while the Galaxy S27 Pro is listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip instead of Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6.
